tasks.title: Wake-with-timeout orchestration (wake.go)
tasks.notes: Wrote internal/telemetry/wake.go. Signature: waitUntilOnline(ctx, svc tesla.VehicleService, creds tesla.Credentials, teslaID int64, timeout time.Duration) (bool, error) — package-private helper for the service. Wraps ctx in context.WithTimeout(timeout), calls WakeUp once, then polls ListVehicles every wakePollInterval (5s) filtering to teslaID's State=="online". Signals distinctly: (true,nil)=online reached; (false,nil)=timeout/ctx-cancel before online (caller maps asleep-timeout); (false,err)=adapter error incl. tesla.ErrUnauthorized (errors.Is) and errVehicleNotListed (vehicle absent from list -> caller maps api-error). Deadline/cancel errors during WakeUp/ListVehicles are treated as timeout, not api-error (isDeadline helper). Pure of storage — only the tesla port. go build/vet green.

tasks.title: Collection service: ports->store, per-account batching, isolation, retry, reason mapping (service.go)
tasks.notes: REWORK REQUIRED (review round 1, finding R1-01, ACCEPTED by leader). collectAccount omits the design-D3 / task-6.1 upfront per-account ListVehicles call: it calls waitUntilOnline for EVERY vehicle, which unconditionally WakeUps even already-online vehicles — wasting a paid Fleet API WakeUp per online vehicle and calling ListVehicles per-vehicle-per-tick instead of once per account. FIX: in collectAccount, after resolving creds, call s.tsla.ListVehicles(ctx, creds) ONCE; build teslaID->State; on that call's ErrUnauthorized record all vehicles unauthorized (no further calls); then per vehicle: if State=="online" skip WakeUp and go straight to VehicleData; if asleep/offline/absent run the wake flow (waitUntilOnline, D4). Re-read design.md D3/D4 for exact semantics. ALSO extend service_test.go: assert an already-online vehicle receives ZERO WakeUp calls and ListVehicles is called once per account (fake tesla must count WakeUp/ListVehicles calls). Prior (now-superseded) impl note: NewService(pool,acct,tsla,cfg) Collector; unexported store seam (dbStore is the only pgtype site); per-vehicle isolation + one api-error retry; exactly one poll_attempt per vehicle; whole-cycle error only if AllRegisteredVehicles fails. Keep all of that; only change the wake path. || REWORK DONE (R1-01 fixed): collectAccount now calls s.tsla.ListVehicles(ctx,creds) EXACTLY ONCE per account via new listStates helper, building a teslaID->State map. On that call's tesla.ErrUnauthorized -> all vehicles recorded unauthorized, NO further Tesla calls; on a non-401 ListVehicles error -> all vehicles recorded api-error (no blind waking). attemptVehicle now takes the pre-read state: State=="online" SKIPS WakeUp and goes straight to VehicleData; asleep/offline/absent runs the bounded wake flow (waitUntilOnline, D4) unchanged. wake.go left intact (still used for asleep vehicles; no signature change). tasks.title: Scheduler: daily 03:30-local daemon + pure nextRun (scheduler.go)
tasks.notes: Wrote internal/telemetry/scheduler.go. Scheduler{collector, hour, minute, loc, now}. NewScheduler(collector, hour, minute, loc, cfg) *Scheduler: nil loc -> time.Local; clock seam uses cfg.Clock else time.Now. Run(ctx) loops: nextRun -> time.NewTimer -> select on ctx.Done()/timer.C; on tick runs one CollectAll (ignoring its error so one bad night never stops the schedule), reschedules next day; returns ctx.Err() on cancellation with NO new cycle started after shutdown begins (graceful, D7). Pure function nextRun(now, hour, minute, loc) time.Time: computed in loc (honors DST / non-local tz), strictly-after semantics (== now rolls to tomorrow). Public constructor signature and Config unchanged. | REWORK (round 1, finding R1-02, ACCEPTED — fold into the same re-dispatch): Scheduler.Run currently does `_, _ = s.collector.CollectAll(ctx)`, discarding the CycleReport + error, and cmd/poller logs nothing per cycle — a background poller that fails silently every night. FIX: after each CollectAll in Run, log a one-line summary (attempted/succeeded/failures-by-reason) and any non-nil error, so operators see nightly outcomes. Add a small test if practical. Task 7 stays done for scheduling correctness; this is the logging add. || REWORK DONE (R1-02 fixed): Scheduler.Run no longer discards the cycle result — it now captures `report, err := s.collector.CollectAll(ctx)` and calls logCycle(report, err), which emits a one-line summary `telemetry cycle: attempted=N succeeded=N failures={reason=count ...}` (failures rendered in a stable reason-sorted order via formatFailures) plus a separate `telemetry cycle: whole-cycle error: <err>` line when err!=nil. Uses the stdlib `log` package (log.Printf), matching cmd/web and cmd/poller. nextRun and the graceful-shutdown/timer semantics (D7) are UNCHANGED. Tests added in scheduler_test.go: TestScheduler_RunsAndLogsOneCycle (fake clock ~10ms before target -> one cycle runs through the logging path, then ctx cancel -> clean context.Canceled shutdown, no panic) and TestFormatFailures (empty map -> ""; deterministic reason-sorted output). go build/vet/test green.

decisions.decision: On the R1-01 fix, when the once-per-account ListVehicles fails with a NON-401 error, record every vehicle for that account as failure/api-error for the cycle rather than falling back to per-vehicle blind waking.

Flagged for reviewer to confirm vs a per-vehicle wake fallback.

findings.location: internal/telemetry/service.go:117-135 (collectAccount) vs openspec/changes/telemetry-add-nightly-snapshots/design.md D3 and tasks.md task 6.1
findings.note: D3 specifies: 'Call ListVehicles once per account to read the current State of all vehicles; if online, fetch immediately; if asleep/offline, run the bounded wake flow.' Task 6.1 explicitly states: 'call ListVehicles once, then per vehicle wake-if-needed (task 5), VehicleData'. The implementation omits the upfront per-account ListVehicles call and instead calls waitUntilOnline (which unconditionally calls WakeUp) for every vehicle regardless of whether it is already online. This means even an online vehicle receives an unnecessary WakeUp API call per nightly cycle, wasting paid Fleet API quota contrary to D3's explicit cost-reduction rationale ('one ListVehicles per account instead of per vehicle'). The task 6.1 checkbox is marked done but the specified behavior is not implemented.

Scheduler.Run discards CollectAll's CycleReport and error with '_, _ = s.collector.CollectAll(ctx)'. cmd/poller logs startup but has no per-cycle log. For a nightly background poller this is an observability gap: if every night's collection fails silently, the only way to detect it is by querying the database. The leader flagged this in task 9 notes as 'a possible observability gap, not a blocker.' Assessed as minor for tier 3 (collection foundation, not operations tier), but worth addressing before production use. Suggested fix: at minimum log the CycleReport summary (attempted/succeeded/failures) and any whole-cycle error after each CollectAll call in Run, or return the report/error to a caller hook.

R1-01 verified fixed. internal/telemetry/service.go:collectAccount now calls s.tsla.ListVehicles(ctx,creds) EXACTLY ONCE per account via the new listStates helper (service.go:172-182), building a teslaID->State map. state=="online" goes straight to VehicleData with ZERO WakeUp calls (attemptVehicle:214-225); asleep/offline/absent runs waitUntilOnline as per D4. Fleet-wide ErrUnauthorized on ListVehicles records all vehicles unauthorized with no further calls (service.go:142-148). Non-401 ListVehicles failure records all vehicles as api-error rather than blindly waking them (service.go:149-158) — the new D1 decision (see below). service_test.go:TestCollectAll_OnlineVehicle_NoWakeStraightToFetch asserts ft.wakeCalls[10]==0 and ft.listCalls==1 with a real call-counting fake; TestCollectAll_AccountWideListVehicles401_AllUnauthorizedNoPerVehicleCalls asserts the 401 short-circuit; TestCollectAll_AsleepVehicle_WakeFlowRuns proves the asleep branch still runs WakeUp. All three tests pass with actual fake-counter assertions, not vacuous. go build./... + go vet./... clean; go test ./internal/telemetry/... -count=1 PASS (19 tests + 4 DB tests self-skipped).

R1-02 verified fixed. scheduler.go:Run (line 72-73) now captures `report, err := s.collector.CollectAll(ctx)` and calls `logCycle(report, err)`. logCycle (scheduler.go:82-88) emits `telemetry cycle: whole-cycle error: <err>` when non-nil and `telemetry cycle: attempted=N succeeded=N failures={reason=count ...}` always, using stdlib log.Printf. formatFailures (scheduler.go:92-110) renders the map in stable sorted order. TestScheduler_RunsAndLogsOneCycle exercises this path and passes (log output visible in test run). nextRun and graceful-shutdown (D7) unchanged.

New leader decision D1 (non-401 ListVehicles failure -> all vehicles api-error, no per-vehicle wake fallback) assessed as ACCEPTABLE under D3/D4. D3 does not specify a fallback for a non-401 list failure; per-vehicle blind waking would re-introduce the WakeUp waste R1-01 targeted. The decision preserves per-vehicle isolation (each vehicle gets exactly one poll_attempt row) and the cycle continues with other accounts. The trade-off (a transient list error skips an account's collection for one night) is acceptable for a nightly snapshot tier where a transient failure will self-heal the next night. No design violation found.
